title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
shortDescription: New Super Mario Bros. Wii is organized in GameAtlas's Wii platformer collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference platformer marker within the Wii catalog.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Listed for the Wii platformer discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
